ops.title: plugin-v1 is a moving tag: move it or the autobump fix never ships
ops.body:
External repos call the plugin autobump as `yasyf/cc-skills/.github/workflows/plugin-autobump.yml@plugin-v1`, and that workflow re-checks out `.github/scripts/plugin_autobump.py` at the same pinned ref (`script-ref` defaults to `plugin-v1`; only cc-skills itself resolves to github.sha). A fix landed on main is therefore inert for every caller until `plugin-v1` is force-moved.

It had been stranded since 2026-07-22: `0ed251d` (carry the bot git identity into the pull/push retry loop) sat unreleased for a month because the tag was never moved. Found while fixing the .cursor-plugin drift false alarm (`f9f7c57`); moving the tag shipped both.

After changing plugin_autobump.py or plugin-autobump.yml:
  git tag -f plugin-v1 origin/main && git push -f origin plugin-v1

Verify against a real caller rather than trusting the unit tests:
  gh workflow run autobump.yml --repo yasyf/slop-cop -f strict=true -f dry_run=true
The weekly cron runs strict by construction (AUTOBUMP_STRICT: github.event_name == 'schedule' || inputs.strict), so strict is the mode that actually gates.
